findings.title: Several nav links have low contrast
findings.detail: Muted text over the hero image sits near 3.2:1.
findings.fix: Increase link color contrast against the banner.

findings.title: Mobile menu targets are under 44px
findings.detail: Hamburger and utility links measure about 32px tall.
findings.fix: Expand tap targets to at least 44×44.

findings.title: Images missing alt text on the landing page

findings.fix: Add short alt text describing each photo.

findings.title: Inconsistent heading sizes
findings.detail: More than a dozen distinct font sizes appear above the fold.
findings.fix: Collapse to a short type scale.

findings.title: PDF link opens a download mid-walk
findings.detail: A same-site QR-Codes link starts a file download instead of a page.
findings.fix: Mark download links clearly or open them in a new tab with a notice.

findings.title: Primary promo CTA fails contrast
findings.detail: Light text on a bright red panel reads under 3:1 in places.
findings.fix: Use darker text or a deeper panel fill.

findings.title: Card carousels overflow on tablet
findings.detail: Horizontal rails clip titles at mid breakpoints.
findings.fix: Allow cards to wrap or expose a clearer scroll affordance.

findings.title: Console error during Characters visit
findings.detail: A third-party script threw after the grid hydrated.
findings.fix: Isolate the failing analytics call and guard the handler.

findings.title: Decorative images missing empty alt
findings.detail: Poster tiles without useful alt text are not marked decorative.
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text, or mark decorative images with an empty alt.

findings.title: No reduced-motion handling on hero
findings.detail: Hero motion runs without a prefers-reduced-motion rule.
findings.fix: Pause non-essential animation when reduced motion is requested.
